summary: Full rebuild (Walkthru v2) tested end to end. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (health, dashboard seed counts + median 400s, vapi tools robustness/pricing/discount cap/needs_human, webhook end-of-call both branches, start-agent invite/resend/400/404, agent switch auto-invite, /dev advance through all 8 statuses + drop, portal open/sign/pay with negative cases, recall, take-over, transcript). Frontend: dashboard (design, funnel counts, filters status/source/ask + empty state, Start agent on Dana -> Invited + 'Sent (simulated)' toast with Copy link, row select updates drawer, Maya On call now card with ticking timer and live estimate, Transcript dialog, Take over prompt + Escalated tag, Recall with cancel/confirm), agent switch On/Off persists, /dev create + auto-invite + Advance 6x with dashboard tab toasting '<name>: <status>' within ~3s each step, portal voice flow at 390px (v1 $19,000-$23,000 -> v2 $25,000-$30,500 with NEW walk-in shower/double vanity lines, natural end -> quote $27,600 -> contract_sent -> pending_deposit $1,380 -> deposit_received, done screen), Talk to change (vinyl -$1,200 v2, 6% discount v3, $18,612), chat mode (suggested chip + typed replies), End early -> fallback with quote_pending, Priya fallback text, mobile dashboard stacks. Found and fixed 1 UI bug (agent switch knob overflow). Sample data reset at the end.

minor.issue: If variableValues.lead_token is missing/unknown, resolve_lead falls back to the most recently active walkthru_initiated lead. A stray end-of-call-report (or a real Vapi call misconfigured without lead_token) would end someone else's live call (e.g. Maya) and price on their lead. Consider only falling back by call.id mapping, or not at all.
Damage detection is keyword-only without negation: 'no leaks' / 'no water damage' / 'no soft spots' adds the $1,800 water damage allowance.
A tool estimate outside a live call on a 'new' or 'invited' lead jumps status straight to quote_generated, skipping walkthru_initiated/completed in status_history (journey shows gaps).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: knob span was absolute without left-0, so in On state the knob rendered at track.x+46px, overflowing the track and covering the 'On' label. Added left-0; verified knob now inside track for both On/Off.

Toasts at top-right sit exactly over the Agentic lead management switch; while a toast is visible (and hovering pauses dismissal) the switch can't be clicked. With 3s polling toasts that's frequent. Move toaster to bottom-right or offset it.

integration_issues.issue: Line 'Let me price a standard package for a medium bath.' is hardcoded. In chat mode, typing 'large' + 'Premium' prices Premium/large ($41,500-$50,500) but the agent still says 'standard package for a medium bath'. Build this line from ctx like the tool args.

issues: 'Take over call' button shows on every lead, including ones with no call (deposit_received, quoted). Consider showing it only when walkthru_initiated.
Journey step for invited reads 'Text sent, link opened' even when the link was never opened.
Phone shown raw as typed ('4085550155') for /dev-created leads; seeded leads are formatted. Format phone for display.
Header on quote/contract/deposit/fallback screens drops the orange logo icon that the welcome screen shows (minor inconsistency).
Maya's seeded transcript has two Homeowner lines in a row with no agent reply between them.

Make the 'Let me price a ... package for a ... bath' line in scripts.js reflect the parsed size/finish

Optional: negation handling for known_issues damage keywords; show Take over only for live calls; format phone numbers
